name: valencia
_doc: Valencia, Spain. Local origin near Catedral / Plaza de la Virgen. Catastro INSPIRE BU 46900, OSM Geofabrik regional snapshot, and supplied historical GIS layers. See STATUS_AND_LIMITS.md for inference/provenance and render caveats.
_historical_note: Active timeline 1238–2026 is medieval-to-modern scope, not city foundation. Roman-era sources are retained for research but excluded from the active sequence. Muslim-wall outline is schematic; valencia_1356 is a broad urban extent, not a verified wall line.
